The catalog read that settles it needs a provisioned target, so HF-TICKET-008-SETTLEMENTS-EXISTENCE-ON-LIVE-TARGET is held by ORCH-004 as an owner action rather than claimed here. Do not author a settlements table to make the reads work - absence is the finding.
evidence: TRANSFERRED, NOT COMPLETED HERE. AC-2 is held by ORCH-004 as an owner action: HF-TICKET-008-SETTLEMENTS-EXISTENCE-ON-LIVE-TARGET settles whether public.settlements exists, and it needs a PROVISIONED TARGET for a catalog read, which this lane has no credential for and must not take under CP-051. No settlements table was authored: absence is the finding, and authoring a table to make the reads work is the failure mode. THE QUESTION REMAINS OPEN.

This lane established what it could WITHOUT a target, read-only: the relation is named by three recorded false-zero read sites, and no CREATE TABLE for it exists in the active chain, in any archive, or in any root-level SQL. That is a repository fact, not a catalog fact, and it does not settle whether a HOSTED target carries the relation out of band — DB-002 documented out-of-band Management API application, so "the chain does not create it" is not evidence that no target has it. That is exactly why the question needs a provisioned target rather than another repository search.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Record the false zero at lib/venue/finance-snapshot.ts:117 for the venue lane, which reports a venue money as unsettled when the truth is unavailable. HF-TICKET-008-SETTLEMENTS-VENUE-FALSE-ZERO is addressed to VENUE-006, not here.
evidence: TRANSFERRED, NOT COMPLETED HERE. THE QUESTION REMAINS OPEN. lib/venue/finance-snapshot.ts was not read or edited by this task; the fix is a caller-side tri-state (unavailable / unpaid / settled) and a database lane has no standing to make it.
